scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c auto "npm run dev --workspace=@edvixa/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@edvixa/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@edvixa/api && npm run build --workspace=@edvixa/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@edvixa/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@edvixa/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
